text: 当我拿出“卖淫合法化，本质是富人对穷人的性剥削合法化”，阁下又该如何反驳？
en: When I put forward “the legalisation of prostitution is, in essence, the legalisation of the sexual exploitation of the poor by the rich”, how would you, sir, refute that?

text: 反驳卖淫合法化，其实有一个很有力的理由，那就是卖淫合法化，实际上是对底层女性的合法剥削。
en: In refuting the legalisation of prostitution, there is in fact a very powerful reason, namely that the legalisation of prostitution is in reality the lawful exploitation of women at the bottom of society.

text: 从全世界的例子来看，卖淫的女性，基本上都是处于社会底层的女性，如果允许卖淫合法化，那么实际上是允许社会中上层，通过支付金钱的方式，合法地使用底层女性的身体。
en: Judging from examples around the world, women who prostitute themselves are basically women at the bottom of society; if prostitution were legalised, that would in effect allow the upper and middle strata of society lawfully to use the bodies of bottom-stratum women through the payment of money.

text: 这其实是一种合法的剥削。
en: This is in fact a form of lawful exploitation.

text: 2004年的时候，英国内政部发布了一份关于卖淫的报告，报告指出，当时英国大概有8万人涉及卖淫活动，她们中的大多数都具有遭受家庭虐待、贫穷、离家出走以及DP依赖的经历。
en: In 2004, the UK Home Office published a report on prostitution. The report pointed out that at the time roughly 80,000 people in Britain were involved in prostitution, and most of them had experienced domestic abuse, poverty, running away from home, and DP dependence.

text: 80%的卖淫的人，曾被家庭虐待，95%的人，被认为是dp使用者。
en: 80% of those who prostitute themselves have suffered domestic abuse, and 95% are considered dp users.

text: 过去五年，伦敦成年男性，大约每十个有一个有过嫖娼的经历。
en: Over the past five years, roughly one in ten adult men in London has had the experience of hiring a prostitute.

text: 荷兰卖淫合法化以后的情况表明，荷兰的性工作者，绝大部分都是非法外国移民，约占80%。
en: The situation in the Netherlands after the legalisation of prostitution shows that the vast majority of sex workers in the Netherlands are illegal foreign migrants, accounting for about 80%.

text: 英国发布的报告和荷兰的情况，实际上能够说明卖淫人士的社会地位。
en: The report published by Britain and the situation in the Netherlands can in fact illustrate the social status of those who prostitute themselves.

text: 这正印证了那句话，不是家里穷，谁出来卖淫啊。
en: This confirms that saying: if not for poverty at home, who would ever come out to prostitute themselves?

text: 但即使再穷，她还是父母眼中的宝，但这块宝，富人只需要付出几张纸，就可以轻易享用。
en: But even if she is ever so poor, she is still the treasure in her parents’ eyes; yet this treasure, the rich need only part with a few notes to enjoy it with ease.

text: 学者的调查还发现，在与性工作者发生关系时，买方很少会尊重他们，变态和暴力是常有的事。
en: Scholars’ investigations have also found that when having sex with sex workers, the buyer rarely shows them respect; perversion and violence are common occurrences.

text: 父母眼中的宝，穷人的尊严，让他人合法地践踏，这很难让人不破防。
en: The treasure in parents’ eyes, the dignity of the poor, allowed to be lawfully trampled by others — it is hard not to be emotionally undone by this.

text: 当然，不排除有些社会地位高的人，出于各种动机去卖淫。
en: Of course, one cannot rule out that some people of high social status prostitute themselves out of various motives.

text: 但是那是极少数，属于卖淫人中的非主流。
en: But those are a tiny minority, belonging to the non-mainstream among those who prostitute themselves.

text: 看到这里可能有人会说，如果一个人家里很穷，已经穷到吃了上顿没下顿的地步，他（她）为什么不能出卖自己的身体赚钱养活自己？
en: Seeing this, some may say: if a person’s family is so poor that they have no food for the next meal after the last, why can he or she not sell their own body to earn money and support themselves?

text: 你所谓的卖淫合法化即剥削合法化的观点，是不是也扼杀了这些人的生存机会。
en: Does your view that the legalisation of prostitution equals the legalisation of exploitation not also deprive these people of their chance to survive?

text: 这种观点其实也有一定道理。
en: This view in fact has some merit.

text: 需要指出的是，如果真的有很多人，穷到了只能出卖身体才能生存的地步，个人认为，他们卖淫，已经属于紧急避险的不可罚的行为。
en: It should be pointed out that if there really are many people so poor that they can only survive by selling their bodies, in my view their prostitution already constitutes an act of necessity that is not punishable.

text: 这时候，无论是合法化，还是非法化，其实对他们都是不可罚的。
en: At such a time, whether legalised or not, in fact they are not punishable.

text: 如果不存在这种情况，那么对个别贫穷的家庭，他们需要的不是卖淫合法化这种虚伪的政策，而是社会的帮扶政策，比如发放救济金或者救济粮等。
en: If such a situation does not exist, then for individual poor families what they need is not a hypocritical policy such as the legalisation of prostitution, but social support policies, such as the provision of relief funds or relief grain.

text: 卖淫是否要合法，这个问题即使在欧洲，也存在巨大的分歧。
en: Whether prostitution should be legalised is a question on which there is, even within Europe, a huge divergence of opinion.

text: 所以，不能指望一两句话，就能反驳或者证成卖淫合法化。
en: Therefore, one cannot expect that a sentence or two could refute or justify the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 尤其是，卖淫这个问题，还涉及到复杂的社会背景。
en: Especially since the issue of prostitution also involves a complex social background.

text: 正如法学家萨维尼所说，法律是民族精神的产物。
en: As the jurist Savigny said, law is the product of the spirit of a nation.

text: 每个民族有不同的民族精神，在卖淫这个问题上，也很难有统一的法律。
en: Every nation has a different national spirit, so on the issue of prostitution it is also difficult to have a unified law.

text: 至于什么卖淫合法化可以降低强奸案件发生等观点，不过是功利主义的表达，无论成立与否，与合法性剥削相比，都是道与术的关系。
en: As for views such as that the legalisation of prostitution can reduce the occurrence of rape cases, they are nothing but expressions of utilitarianism; whether they hold or not, compared with lawful sexual exploitation, they are a matter of principle versus expedient technique.

text: 参考
en: Reference

text: ^夏菲：《从英国经验看我国卖淫形势政策的变革》，《犯罪研究》2009年3期。
en: ^ Fei Xia, ‘On the Reform of Our Country’s Prostitution Policy in Light of the British Experience’, Crime Research, 2009, issue 3.

text: 因为劳动价值论是自由主义者和社会主义者共同认可的一条公理，如果性行为算是劳动的话，那么难道所有的雌性动物都是劳动者的一员吗？
en: Because the labour theory of value is an axiom commonly accepted by both liberals and socialists, if sexual acts counted as labour, then are all female animals members of the labour force?

text: 如果性行为算是劳动的话，那么这种劳动生产了什么样的货物和服务呢？
en: If sexual acts counted as labour, then what kind of goods and services does this labour produce?

text: 劳动是人类的固有属性，为什么人类的历史会从旧石器时代开始而不是更早的灵长类祖先开始呢？
en: Labour is an inherent attribute of humankind; why does human history begin from the Old Stone Age rather than from the earlier primate ancestors?

text: 是因为正是从旧石器时代人类才有了生产工具和社会分工的概念，劳动是塑造人类社会的最主要动力。
en: It is because it was only from the Old Stone Age that humans came to have the concept of production tools and the social division of labour, and labour is the chief driving force shaping human society.

text: 如果合法化的话，卖淫成为产业自然也是正当的，毕竟法无禁止即自由嘛。
en: If it were legalised, prostitution becoming an industry would naturally also be legitimate, after all, what is not forbidden by law is freedom.

text: 然而卖淫并不会创造任何价值，害处还有不少。
en: Yet prostitution creates no value whatsoever, and its harms are plentiful.

text: 根据奥卡姆剃刀的“凡无必要，勿增实体”，卖淫合法化的必要性在哪里呢？
en: According to Occam’s razor, ‘do not multiply entities beyond necessity’, where is the necessity for the legalisation of prostitution?

text: 天天骂房地产金融是蛀虫最起码人家真能产出水泥盒子和资金周转服务，对它俩都有意见你们是怎么能为卖淫这种纯粹的蛀虫甚至毒虫拍手叫好的？
en: You curse real estate and finance as parasites day in and day out, yet at least they genuinely produce concrete boxes and capital-circulation services; if you have objections to both of them, how can you applaud prostitution, this purely parasitic — even poisonous — entity?

text: 历史上的废奴运动废除的可不只有贩奴，还有契约奴。
en: The abolitionist movement in history abolished not only the slave trade but also indentured servitude.

text: 按照支持卖淫合法化的逻辑，为什么契约奴也要废除呢？
en: Following the logic of those who support the legalisation of prostitution, why was indentured servitude also abolished?

text: 自愿借钱然后还不起了，用人身自由来抵债不是很正当的吗？
en: If one freely borrows money and then cannot repay it, is it not perfectly proper to use one’s personal freedom to settle the debt?

text: 因为无论自由主义者还是社会主义者都有这样一个共识：针对人身体本身的剥削是不可以被接受的。
en: Because both liberals and socialists share this consensus: exploitation directed at the human body itself cannot be accepted.

text: 二者只是对于经济上的剥削有分歧而已，社会主义者认为剥削是私有制市场之下的原罪，而自由主义者认为权力破坏了市场自由从而产生剥削，在自由的市场中资本与劳动力的公平交易不会产生剥削。
en: The two only differ on economic exploitation: socialists hold that exploitation is the original sin under the private-property market, whereas liberals hold that power destroys market freedom and thereby gives rise to exploitation, and that in a free market the fair exchange of capital and labour-power does not produce exploitation.

text: 如果你可以接受卖淫，那你就没资格抱怨加班调休低工资和各种黑心老板了，毕竟你连最赤裸裸的肉体剥削都可以接受甚至喝彩，有什么资格不对经济上的剥削欣然接受呢？
en: If you can accept prostitution, then you have no right to complain about overtime, compensatory leave, low wages, and various unscrupulous bosses; after all, if you can accept even the most naked physical exploitation, even cheering it on, by what right would you not readily accept economic exploitation?

text: 私有制之下彩礼和包养可以视为一种赠与关系，但是卖淫就是毫无疑问的赤裸裸的肉体剥削。
en: Under private ownership, bride price and being kept can be regarded as a kind of gift relationship, but prostitution is unquestionably naked physical exploitation.

text: 就算我们可以讲卖淫视为正当的行业，但是当对于非处和女性的穿衣自由存在广泛的恶意时（甚至与支持卖淫的群体高度重合），即使按照自由主义者的观点，不自由和公平的市场也是剥削的来源。
en: Even if we could regard prostitution as a legitimate industry, when there is widespread malice towards non-virgins and women’s freedom of dress (overlapping to a high degree even with the camp that supports prostitution), then even by the liberal view, an unfree and unfair market is also a source of exploitation.

text: 所以想证明卖淫的合理，请先平等对待处和非处，并且不要对于女性的着装指指点点。
en: So if you wish to justify prostitution, please first treat virgins and non-virgins equally, and do not nitpick at women’s clothing.

text: 基于双方平等且完全自愿的性自由是人的自由解放的一部分，人有权利寻求这些自然的快乐。
en: Sexual freedom based on equality between both parties and complete voluntariness is part of humankind’s emancipatory freedom; people have the right to seek these natural pleasures.

text: 而基于金钱的性交易则是对人体物化交易的一部分。
en: Whereas sex trade based on money is part of the commodification and exchange of the human body.

text: 金钱交易本身体现了权力对人的支配。
en: The money transaction itself reflects the domination of people by power.

text: 看似公平交换但实际上有一方在私有制下是处于生活所迫的不平等不自由下的，是赤裸裸的人身剥削。
en: It appears to be a fair exchange, but in reality one party, under private ownership, is in a state of inequality and unfreedom compelled by livelihood — it is naked exploitation of the person.

text: 至于含有色情元素的文艺作品则是公民言论自由与出版自由的一部分，一切审核制度都是值得废除的。
en: As for literary and artistic works containing pornographic elements, they are part of citizens’ freedom of speech and freedom of publication; all censorship systems are worth abolishing.

text: 这些就是我的态度。
en: This is my stance.
